content: Anọng p'Israẹl arori ọvaarnọng
Mada Samwẹl ọkk'ọtzama, ọrọbha va pẹ p'ijinọng bi bẹ ade akpaar-aponga p'Israẹl.
Ocheden-nwa kwẹ wa okpen Joẹl, ottong afa okpena Abija, wa bẹ ade akpaar-aponga ka Beershẹba.
Yina, wa va mba pẹ, kẹ ka ndọkhi katzori. Wa bẹ asi afhọra, bẹ am-abira achi ngwu, atzima abhakhi aponga ewobha.
Mẹ wọ, adeden-nọng p'Israẹl biphyir ayeri ayok bẹ atzobha, bẹ afona atza akhebha Samwẹl ka Rama.
Bẹ aben-ẹ bi, “Kọ akk'atzama, yina, va pọ p'ijinọng, kọ ka ndọkhi katzori. Mẹ wọ, nang man ọvaarnọng kw'ọ́dabh man, mach'idibhon idọdọk biphyir ikhaam.”
Yina, mada bẹ abeni bi, “Kọ nang man ọvaarnọng kw'ọttọhna aponga paman.” Wa odik nwa obhem Samwẹl ettem. Mẹ wọ, ozi njọhm ọnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Samwẹl bi, “Yonga itzọhng anang anọng mba k'odik kpenamkpen kwa bẹ am-agbaak anang-ọ. Kọ rang kwa bẹ abhumi e, bẹ abhumi kaam mach'ọvaarnọng kwabẹ e.
Ttẹwọr kẹ da ndim bẹ mbina k'Ijip, ma apyiri ma, bẹ am-akpa nnam abọr-m, bẹ am-abira akpobha akha, mando kwa bẹ am-asọ-ọ mẹ e.
Kọ yonga itzọhng anang bẹ, yina, tzọr bẹ itzọhng. Tte bẹ aronga odik dema kw'ọvaarnọng kw'ọ́daabh bẹ ósi bẹ o.”
Wa Samwẹl ọtzọkha idik nna biphyir s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọgbaakhi, ọgbaak anọng mba p'am-aror ọvaarnọng abọbh-ẹ.

Oben bẹ bi, “Ma wọ ode odik kw'ọvaarnọng kw'ọ́dabh bọng ósi, kẹ ọ́tzọkha va pabọng p'ijinọng, bẹ an-ade anọng p'abaabh-ẹ p'áyaar akpaar pẹ pa nnyanyaang mmindọr, ọmaana ayari-nnyanyaang. Bẹ án-arọbh k'itzitzikha s'akpaar mba.

Ósi ayok bani adenho p'agbong-nọng nnọhna nnọhna, bani adenho p'agbong-nọng arọbh afa obhiri jobh. Ótzekha ayok bani bẹ ade anọng p'áyaabha ekpo pyẹ, bẹ abira asi ipha sẹ. Ayongi mẹ, kẹ ótzekha ayok bani bẹ ade atzetzekha p'am-aduk egbongkpo, ọmaana ẹtzọhmkpo py'akpaar pẹ.
Kẹ ọ́tzọkha va pabọng p'ipanọng, ifha bẹ am-asi ana p'adaami eruk anang-ẹ, abira awọhn ọchattọhk, abira asi brẹd pẹ.
Kẹ ọ́bọkha bọng iwoni ọkkakka sabọng ọna, ọmaana iwoni sa grep ttara s'oliv, ọ́tzọkha ọnang akhaan-nọng pẹ akkeri.
Kẹ ọ́tzọkha okhung wani k'akhung jobh p'abọkpa pabọng, ọmaana ka grep pabọng, ọ́tzọkha ọnang akhaan-nọng pẹ, ttara atzọhmnọng pẹ.
Kẹ ọ́tzọkha atzọhmnọng pabọng p'ijinọng, ọmaana p'ipanọng, ọmaana abhaam pabọng akkakka, ttara nnyanyaang sabọng biphyir ótzima osi itzọhm sẹ.
Kẹ ọ́tzọhka ibe rani k'obe jobh k'arukhimaan pabọng, bọbọng ọkhaam ma for sabọng ábira ade abira pẹ.
Mada ewu nduma ebenga, bọng ábhom áror ẹkkaana ka mbọhk s'ọvaarnọng kwa bọng akk'atzekha, yina, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi bọng ẹmọng kósi.”
Kaambi mẹ wọ, anọng mba bẹ Samwẹl itzọhng kayong, be an-aben bi, “Man kokher! Morori ọvaarnọng kw'ọ́daabh man e.
Mẹ wọ kwa móde mach'idibhon idọdọk biphyir, da mọ́khaama ọvaarnọng kw'ọ́dabh man, kw'óm-obiro ochi man eden, óbiro órima mgbong saman.”
Mada Samwẹl ọbhaang idik nna biphyir s'anọng mba agbaakhi, obiro ọtzọkha sẹ ọgbaak Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.
Mẹ wọ e, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi obhina bi, “Kọ khera macha bẹ abeni, anang bẹ ọvaarnọng.” Mẹ wọ, wa Samwẹl oben ajinọng p'Israẹl bi, “Tte ọnọng-ọnọng ọrọhng ọbhana ka kẹ k'obhon.”
